summary: Innventure, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on September 21, 2026, reporting board changes. Michael Otworth and John Hewitt resigned as directors effective September 18, 2026, in connection with the Board's initiative to increase independent director representation; neither resignation stemmed from disagreement with the Company. The Board appointed Michael Madon as an independent director effective September 28, 2026, filling Otworth's vacancy, with no committee assignment yet determined. Madon will receive the standard non-management director compensation and enter into a standard indemnification agreement. This is a governance matter, not a special situation.
